item.title: Seven killed, one seriously hurt after private jet crashes during takeoff in Maine
item.description: Federal officials confirmed that seven people were killed and one crew member was critically injured after a private business jet crashed and burst into flames while taking off from Bangor International Airport in Maine on Sunday evening.
